component_labels.policy_levy: Policy costs (CfD, RO, FiT, WHD, Nuclear RAB)

BSUoS.meaning: Balancing Services Use of System charge; NESO's balancing costs, charged to demand only since Apr 2023.

CfD.meaning: Contracts for Difference; low-carbon support scheme with LCCC as counterparty, funded by a levy on suppliers.

DESNZ.meaning: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero; sets energy policy and the CfD and Capacity Market schemes.

DNO.meaning: Distribution Network Operator; owns and runs the local wires in one of 14 licence areas.

DUoS.meaning: Distribution Use of System charge; set by the DNO within Ofgem-approved revenue.

ESC.meaning: Electricity Settlements Company; government-owned. Settles Capacity Market payments and collects the supplier charge that funds them.

Elexon.meaning: Administers the Balancing and Settlement Code and settles imbalances; owned by the largest BSC parties since Oct 2024.

FiT.meaning: Feed-in Tariffs; support scheme for small-scale generation, closed to new applicants since Apr 2019. Cost recovered from suppliers.

IDNO.meaning: Independent distribution network operator; runs embedded networks (often new-build estates) inside a DNO area.

LCCC.meaning: Low Carbon Contracts Company; government-owned counterparty to CfDs. Collects the CfD levy from suppliers.

equivalent.US: ISO/RTO (system operation only; runs no energy market)

NESO.meaning: National Energy System Operator; publicly owned since Oct 2024, balances GB in real time, sets TNUoS/BSUoS, plans the network, owns no network assets.

NGET.meaning: National Grid Electricity Transmission; transmission owner in England and Wales.

OFTO.meaning: Offshore transmission owner; owns the cable from an offshore wind farm to the onshore grid. Licensed by Ofgem through competitive tender.

Ofgem.meaning: GB energy regulator; licenses, sets network price controls (RIIO) and the default tariff cap.

Price cap.meaning: Ofgem's quarterly ceiling on domestic default tariffs; the supplier sets the actual price at or below it.

RAB.meaning: Regulated asset base model; funds Sizewell C construction through a levy on suppliers.

RIIO.meaning: Ofgem's network price-control framework (Revenue = Incentives + Innovation + Outputs); RIIO-3 for transmission from Apr 2026.

RO.meaning: Renewables Obligation; legacy support scheme. From Apr 2026 the Exchequer pays 75% of the domestic cost.

SHET.meaning: Scottish Hydro Electric Transmission (SSEN Transmission); transmission owner in northern Scotland.

SPT.meaning: SP Transmission (ScottishPower); transmission owner in southern Scotland.

Supplier.meaning: Licensed retailer; buys wholesale energy, pays network charges and levies, bills the customer.

TNUoS.meaning: Transmission Network Use of System charge; set by NESO within Ofgem-approved revenue and passed to the TOs.

VAT.meaning: Value added tax; domestic electricity 0% from 1 Oct 2026 to 31 Mar 2027 (normally 5%), business 20%.

WHD.meaning: Warm Home Discount; annual bill rebate for eligible low-income households. Cost spread across supplier bills.

BA.meaning: Balancing authority; balances load and generation within its area.

CCA.meaning: Community Choice Aggregation; a city or county buys power for residents by default while the IOU keeps wires and billing.

Default service.meaning: Supply for customers who don't pick a retailer in restructured states.

FERC.meaning: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission; regulates wholesale markets and interstate transmission.

equivalent.GB: NESO (system operation only; no energy market)

ISO/RTO.meaning: Independent System Operator / Regional Transmission Organization; operates the grid and wholesale markets and owns no wires.

LSE.meaning: Load-serving entity; buys wholesale power for end customers.

NERC.meaning: North American Electric Reliability Corporation; sets reliability standards approved by FERC and enforced through regional entities.

NOIE.meaning: Non-opt-in entity; an ERCOT municipal utility or co-op that has not opted in to retail competition.

PCIA.meaning: Power Charge Indifference Adjustment; California exit fee paid by CCA and Direct Access customers.

RA.meaning: Resource adequacy; California's capacity obligation on LSEs, set by the CPUC and munis (no central auction).
